sentences.text: 2.In compliance of the order of this Court, dated 07.06.2003, the concerned Official of the respondent appeared in person before this Court.
He submitted that the entire compensation awarded by the Tribunal is paid to the claimant.
3.The learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that since the amount awarded by the Tribunal is not deposited, the claimant had filed the present appeal for enhancement of compensation.
Now the amount awarded by the Tribunal is https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis released and hence, the application may be dismissed.
